what: On desktop the closed page is the older plain card: no lock icon, a 16px title, a 13px grey line, then a grey 'Back to Home' pill. The content fills the left 270px of an 812px card and the rest of the page (550px) is blank canvas. The phone version of the same page has the 48px lock tile and no button. The band already has '‹ Home', so 'Back to Home' is the second control for one destination.
why: Consistency and the peak-end rule: a refusal is the lowest moment in a Manager's day and it is the least designed page they see. Two designs for one state (phone vs desktop) reads as unfinished. Same root cause as OW-019 (the desktop 404 uses the same plain card).
fix: Draw the Direction B state card at both widths: 48px grey icon holder with the bold lock, title 600 16/22 ink, line 14.5/20 #3F4A4F, 14px gap between icon and text, 16px card padding, card capped at 560px wide on desktop. Remove 'Back to Home' (the band's back link does it) and put the one useful next step in its place (see MG-002).
where: src/components/owner-only-notice.tsx:27-33 (line 29 is the B card shown on phones; line 33 is the CorpEmpty shown on desktop); src/app/app/owner-b-pages.css:513-514; state card spec in src/app/app/b-foundation.css:237-243

what: The notice says who can help ('Jose Natal can give you payroll access.') and stops. There is no way to ask Jose from here and no pointer to the Manager's own part of the job. The component already supports a next step (`next`), and other closed pages use it ('Open Timecards', 'Open Things to do'); Payroll and Settings pass none.
why: Empty states point forward (better-writing). A Manager who lands on Payroll usually wants one of two things: their own pay, or to get timecards ready. Both exist and neither is offered. Without a next step the page reads as a wall, not a redirect.
fix: Payroll: title 'Payroll is for Owners'; line 'Your part is timecards. Jose Natal runs payroll after you approve them.'; tinted teal pill 'Open Timecards' (/app/timecards) and a text link 'See my pay' (/app/my-pay). Settings: title 'Settings are for Owners'; line 'You can change scheduling rules. For anything else, ask Jose Natal.'; tinted pill 'Open Scheduling rules' (/app/schedule/settings). Buttons 44px tall, tinted (teal-50 fill, teal text), not filled.

screens: Home (390, 1440), Timecards, Time exports, Things to do
what: The Manager's Home lead card says 'PAYDAY · Friday, Nov 20 · 11 timecards to review · Before payroll' with a full-width white 'Open timecards' button. That button opens Timecards, whose sub-line says 'Approval opens Mon, Nov 16' and 'Approved 0/12': nothing can be approved today. The same work is counted four ways: 11 (Home), 12 people (Timecards), 22 (Things to do, two weeks), 'Approve 11 timecards first' / '12 not finalized' (Time exports).
why: Hierarchy and trust: the strongest surface on Home sends a Manager to a task that is not open yet, and the number changes on every page they pass. The card is also framed around Payroll, which is closed to them.
fix: For a Manager, reframe the ink card around their deadline: eyebrow 'TIMECARDS', big line 'Approve by Mon, Nov 16' (or 'Opens Mon, Nov 16' before the week closes), detail '11 to approve · Payday Fri, Nov 20', chip 'In 5 days'. Button label 'Review timecards'; before approval opens, make it the quiet glass pill 'See this week's hours', not the white pill. Use one count everywhere: timecards the signed-in person can approve for the period shown (11), and say '11 of 12' where the twelfth is their own.
where: src/components/owner-b/home-b.tsx:147-165 (PaydayTile; label switch at line 165, line 154 is 'Before payroll')

what: Elena's own timecard sits in the list like any other ('Elena Ruiz · 16 h 08 · In progress'), and 'Timecards to approve' names her among the cards she must approve ('Carlos, Daniel, Elena, Gabriela…', count 22). She cannot approve her own: the code blocks it and only says so after she opens the card ('Another manager approves your own timecard.'). In a business with one Manager there is no other manager. The Owner (Jose Natal, 'No time yet') is also in her Team list on the phone.
why: Disabled means unavailable, and say why before the click (better-accessibility, better-writing). The row promises an action it will refuse, and the refusal names a person who may not exist.
fix: Mark the row: a grey 'You' chip after the name (12.5/16, 600, #F0F2F3 fill) and the status 'Jose approves this one' in place of 'In progress' once the week closes. Leave her card out of the 'to approve' counts and name lists (22 becomes 20; '11 of 12'). Copy in the card: 'Jose Natal approves your timecard.' (use the Owners' names, as the closed pages already do; fall back to 'An Owner approves your timecard.').

what: The band says '13 things need you' and the tabs say 'All 13 · Shifts 2 · Time 1 · Requests 10'. Below, two more cards carry counts that are not in the 13: 'Time corrections · waiting 4' and 'Timecards to approve · waiting 22'. The Time tab says 1 while five time rows wait on the page, and the four corrections can be approved today (Time corrections shows Approve on each).
why: One number, one meaning. A Manager who clears 13 things still has 26 items on the page; the headline cannot be trusted as a finish line (goal-gradient). Also applies to the Owner; it is not in the Owner list.
fix: Count what can be decided today in the headline (13 + 4 corrections = 17) and move what is not open yet into one closed card at the bottom: 'Opens Mon, Nov 16 · 22 timecards', grey, no count pill. Drop the '· waiting' suffix (OW-014).

screens: Phone tab bar, every Manager page (390); sidebar (1440)
what: With Payroll gone, the Manager's fourth phone tab is 'To do' with a red count pill ('13') that stays on every screen, including forms and closed pages. The bell beside the avatar shows no count. On desktop the same red pill sits in the sidebar while Things to do is fifth in the list, below Team.
why: Colour rule: red means stop. Thirteen routine approvals in red on every page is a permanent alarm, and it outranks the page's own primary action. Extends OW-028, but on the Manager's phone it is always on screen. Order: approving requests is the Manager's main job and it sits last.
fix: Count pill in teal (#0B6E69 fill, white 11.5px 700, 18px tall) on both the tab and the sidebar; reserve red for an item past its deadline. For Managers, order the sidebar Home, Things to do, Schedule, Time, Team; on the phone keep five tabs but place To do second.
where: src/lib/navigation.ts:147 (sidebar order), 266-272 (phone tabs); count pill styles in src/app/app/owner-b-shell.css

what: Two different things are called More. The sidebar group 'More' holds Insights and Updates. The page 'More' (opened from the avatar) holds My pay, Scheduling rules, Help and Sign out. Scheduling rules, the only setting a Manager has, and My pay are in neither the sidebar nor a visible menu; while the More page is open the sidebar lights Home.
why: Labels describe their destination; one name, one place. An Owner finds Scheduling rules in Settings; a Manager has no Settings and no signpost.
fix: Rename the sidebar group 'Reports and updates' or drop its label (two items need no heading). Add 'Scheduling rules' and 'My pay' to the Manager's sidebar under it, or title the avatar page 'Account' and keep only profile, My pay, Help, Sign out there. Do not light Home on it.
where: src/lib/navigation.ts:53-62 (items folded out of the sidebar), 147-148, 182-183

what: 'No notifications yet · You'll see requests and schedule changes here.' while five time-off requests arrived 'Just now' and '1 min ago' and 13 things wait. The card has no icon and no action; on desktop it is a 76px strip in an otherwise empty page.
why: The copy makes a promise the page is breaking at that moment. Either Managers are not notified of requests (a product gap worth checking) or the line is wrong for them. Empty states point forward.
fix: If Managers are not notified of requests: 'Nothing new · Requests from your team are in Things to do.' with a tinted pill 'Open Things to do (13)'. Use the state card: 48px grey holder with the bold bell, title 600 16/22, line 14.5/20.

what: Every Settings address (Locations, Features, Company profile) shows the identical page: title 'Settings', 'Settings are for Owners', 'Jose Natal can change a setting for you.' The four captures are byte-identical. The page never names what the Manager asked for.
why: Recognition: someone who followed a link to Locations is told about 'a setting'. Small grammar drift across closed pages too: 'Payroll is for Owners' (no period), 'Insights is for Owners and Managers.' (period), 'Settings are for Owners'.
fix: Name the section in the line: 'Locations are part of Settings, which only Owners can change. Ask Jose Natal.' Keep the title 'Settings'. One rule for these titles: no closing period, 'X is for Owners' / 'X are for Owners'.

what: A Manager can open Time exports ('Download hours for payroll', 'Columns your payroll provider needs') although Payroll is closed to them. The blocking line says 'Approve 11 timecards first' while the note under the disabled button says 'Only finalized timecards are exported.' Approve and finalize are two steps and the page uses both words for the one thing in the way. Approval is not open until Monday, which the page does not say.
why: One vocabulary. The disabled button's reason should be the single next action, and it should be something the reader can do.
fix: One line above the button: 'Nothing to export yet · Timecards for Nov 9-15 can be approved from Mon, Nov 16.' Remove the second note. If only Owners finalize, say so: 'Jose Natal finalizes the week after you approve.' Sub-line on the Timecards link row for Managers: 'Download hours for Jose' is too personal; use 'Download approved hours'.

what: On desktop Home the only answer to 'who is working right now' is the tile 'Clocked in 2/8'. The names are one click away (the tile opens the attendance view, not captured). The phone Schedule shows it well ('Carlos Vega · Working', 'Gabriela Santos · 49 min late'). Under Things to do the left column ends at y=760 with a 300px hole (OW-031).
why: A Manager runs the floor; names matter more than a ratio. The space is already there.
fix: Put an 'On now' card in the hole under Things to do, Manager and Owner alike: up to 6 rows, 56px each, 36px avatar with the green ring for working and the amber ring for late, name, shift time and place, chip 'Working' / '49 min late' / 'Not in yet'; footer link 'See everyone'.

screens: Things to do: Shift swaps, Can't work (390, 1440)
what: Swap rows show one name and one shift ('Ana Colon · Tue, Nov 17 · 12:00 PM - 8:00 PM'). Ana appears twice with different dates; nothing says who she is swapping with or which way. 'Can't work' rows do not say whether cover exists. Time off rows carry Approve and Decline; swaps and call-outs, equally a Manager's decision, carry only a chevron.
why: The title should carry the distinguishing fact (as OW-002 asks for corrections). Uneven actions make the list look half built. Applies to the Owner too; not in the Owner list.
fix: Swap title 'Ana Colon ⇄ James Ortiz', sub-line 'Sat, Nov 21, 12-8 PM for Mon, Nov 23, 9 AM-5 PM'. Can't work title 'James Ortiz can't work Fri, Nov 20', sub-line '9 AM-5 PM · No cover yet' in amber-ink. Give both the same trailing zone as Time off: tinted 'Review' pill, 44px.

what: The band says 'Manager · Northside Café & Bakery' and nothing else about the role. The page does not say which locations Elena manages or what Manager access covers. A small grey lock sits beside the phone number with no reason given. On the phone the email breaks mid-address ('elena.ruiz@' / 'example.test').
why: A Manager's reach is the one thing that differs from an Owner and it is shown nowhere. An unexplained lock is a control with no name.
fix: Add a row 'Access · Manager, all locations' (or the location names) with a sub-line 'Schedule, time, team and requests. Payroll and Settings are for Owners.' Replace the bare lock with a 12.5px grey line under the value: 'Jose Natal can change this.' Email: `overflow-wrap: anywhere` off, keep on one line with an ellipsis and full value on tap, or stack the value under the label below 400px.

what: Closed Settings lights the Home tab; closed Payroll lights no tab. Insights says '‹ More' in the band and lights Home.
why: Location feedback should follow one rule.
fix: Pages opened from the avatar or More light no tab (or always Home); pick one and apply it to all three.

what: The lock sits in a 48px rounded square (about 14px radius). Every other icon holder in the Manager app is a circle (Things to do rows, More rows, Timecards links).
fix: Make the state card's holder a circle (border-radius 999px), or decide the rounded square is the state shape and document it. Either way one shape.

why: Empty states and lists should point forward; a card per row is weak grouping.
fix: One card titled 'Not sent · 1' with Miguel's row and a trailing tinted pill 'Remind' (44px). Deadline row sub-line: 'People are reminded the day before.' Also applies to the Owner.
